services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: Seward, Alaska - Private Charters - Resurrection Bay - Kenai Fjords National Park. We can set up any of our regular sightseeing tours as a private charter for you, or you can even customize your own. Our ‘small boat’ tours are a great way to see whales, wildlife & glaciers without the crowds. A private charter allows much more freedom to pursue your own adventure. Call to discuss the possibilities. What to Wear: Seward, Alaska is often referred to as a ‘Temperate Rain Forrest’ and for good reason, although we do get several beautiful sunny and warm days each season. We suggest you dress in layers so that you can adjust for the weather of the moment. A waterproof outer layer is recommended.

services.name: Seward Boat Tours
services.desc: Meet up with the Captain in the Seward small boat harbor and climb aboard! Heated cabins with inside seating, and enclosed marine head (Restrooms) are standard on our boat tours. Our ‘small boat’ tours are a great way to see wildlife without the crowds. Summer in Alaska is whale season and the waters around Seward are a great place to find whales as well as other wildlife. Humpbacks are a regular sighting from mid May through July, and sightings are possible into September. We also see Killer Whales (Orca) on occasion. blurb: Northern Latitude Adventures offers small group tours for whale watching, glacier viewing, and wildlife cruises in Seward, Alaska. They focus on sustainable tourism and are certified by Adventure Green Alaska. They participate in marine conservation efforts and encourage guest support for environmental projects.
